band: PASS iff pooled per-cell median DSI >= 0.3 (T4 on ON bar, T5 on OFF bar) AND T4a-d distinct preferred directions >= 3 AND T5a-d distinct >= 3 AND defined-DSI fraction >= 0.5; preregistered before the sweep

params_provenance.source: flyvis 1.2.0 (pip), released pretrained ensemble flow/0000, Lappalainen et al. 2024 Nature 634:1132
params_provenance.download: flyvis download-pretrained (package's public Google Drive distribution; SHA256 checksums verified by the downloader: results_pretrained_models.zip 71c78d40..., results_umap_and_clustering.zip 6300ec1e...)
params_provenance.checkpoint: chkpts/chkpt_00000 per model (sole released checkpoint; verified identical to what NetworkView.init_network() recovers)

task_optimal_subset.definition: cluster 0 of Ensemble.cluster_indices('T4c') on the RELEASED precomputed UMAP+GMM clustering; flyvis relabels clusters by ascending task error, so cluster 0 is the paper's task-optimal T4c-tuning cluster (Lappalainen 2024 Fig. 4)
task_optimal_subset.caveat: sklearn emitted InconsistentVersionWarning unpickling the stored clustering (built with 1.1.1, read with the installed version); labels and mask are stored values, not refit, and the ensemble-consistency check in cluster_indices passed

params_provenance.aggregation: arithmetic mean (and std) over models of raw checkpoint values; alpha clamped >=0 per model before averaging (flyvis clamps at use); negative raw alphas encountered: 0
params_provenance.alpha_semantics: weight_ij = sign_pair * syn_count_ij * alpha_pair (VERIFIED, flyvis/network/dynamics.py PPNeuronIGRSynapses.write_derived_params); alpha is the per-type-pair unitary strength multiplying the synapse count, units a.u. per synapse; flyvis init was rho/<N>_pair, rho=0.01 (VERIFIED, flyvis/network/initialization.py SynapseCountScaling)
params_provenance.units: tau in ms (checkpoint stores seconds); v_rest and alpha in flyvis a.u.

alpha_mapping: W_ij = curated_sign(pre) * alpha_trained(pair) * N_ij(MaleCNS); flyvis alpha multiplies counts (does NOT absorb them; verified in dynamics.py). ASSUMPTION: MaleCNS counts comparable per-pair to flyvis's FIB25-derived counts; global scale absorbed by gain calibration, relative per-pair scale uncorrected (header)
calibration_declared: fc2 procedure unchanged (held-out +45deg diagonal, 5 col/s, both polarities, argmin |log(median peak evoked/0.5)|, stability-gated); grid EXTENDED before any run by continuing the {1,3}x10^k pattern to 3e3 (unit analysis, header); identical grid for every config including the control
expected_tier_note: repo base rate for expected-to-help changes is 0/12; pass/fail open until run

alpha_coverage.fallback_rule: alpha = 0.01 / mean_nonzero_patch_count(pair) (flyvis init formula; declared, header)
